summary: FD_TC_207_Not Eligible | Bus Segment Disrupted | Customer Missed Connecting Flight | APPR
title: Not Eligible | Bus Segment Disrupted | Customer Missed Connecting Flight | APPR
description:
Validates that when a customer's AC-sold itinerary includes a ground bus segment (YOW?YUL) connecting to a flight (YUL?CDG), and the bus is delayed causing the customer to miss the connecting flight, DDS correctly returns NOT ELIGIBLE. Only flight segments are evaluated for APPR/EU/ASL compensation. Bus/train disruptions do not qualify under any regime. Goodwill (GW) may be offered at business discretion but is not automatic.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Marc-Andr� Pelletier), 2-segment AC-sold itinerary: Segment 1 = Bus YOW?YUL (scheduled dep 08:00, arr 10:00), Segment 2 = Flight AC 870 YUL?CDG (scheduled dep 13:00, arr 02:00+1). Bus delayed 3 hours (actual arr YUL 13:00). Customer missed AC 870. No rebooking available same day. Disruption on bus segment only � flight AC 870 departed on time. Carrier: AC-sold (bus operated by ground partner). 72hrs: Elapsed. Time limit: Within 366 days. No duplicate case. Not employee, not infant.
